THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
142
STUDY 151
Vintage Print Top & Black Shorts
Rights check
Source: 25044.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy copper-red
hair pulled into a loose bun wears round wire glasses
and a black choker. She wears a fitted pink
vintage-print long-sleeve top with black contrast
sleeves and a crew neckline. Black low-rise cargo
shorts sit under a studded black belt, with white ribbed
socks and black platform boots. Her expression is calm
and direct. A soft blue gradient backdrop with even
light. Palette of blush pink, black, and soft sky blue.
Playful and retro, in the style of a Y2K streetwear
catalog.
Playful, retro, edgy
WORKING NOTES
- The vintage print and studded belt are the defining
details.
- Keep the print abstract to avoid readable text in the
image.
Try this: Keep the print abstract, without readable text.
